entities.summary: Jean III de Schulemberg, comte de Montejeu[x], of distant Prussian origin, was born at the château de Guincourt, son of Jean, seigneur de Montejeu and his wife Anne, daughter of Jean d'Averhoult, seigneur de La Lobe.
